title: Six of the eight Hill constants a promotion ships have no out-of-sample score at all — the 2026-07-29 promotion shipped a −34.6% IDP curve change on the strength of an offense-only ±4.8% verdict
subsystem: Model registry / Hill curve promotion gate
claimUnderTest: CLAUDE.md: 'It produces a challenger, scores it against dynasty boards the fit never reads, records the verdict.' Read naturally, the challenger is the parameter set.
observed: A ModelVersion carries all eight CONSTANT_NAMES and `apply` writes all eight. But evaluate_offense_master() takes exactly (c, s) and the registry's holdout.params for champion v2 is {'c': 0.11, 's': 1.11} — the OFFENSE pair only. hill_masters.py names this honestly (VALIDATED_PARAMS = HILL_PERCENTILE_C/S, 'only these two of the eight have a genuine out-of-sample check today'), but that honesty does not reach the version-level `qualified: true` flag, the `confidence: measured` label, `status` output, or CLAUDE.md. The v1→v2 promotion of 2026-07-29 therefore shipped, unscored: HILL_GLOBAL_PERCENTILE_S 0.87→0.725, IDP_HILL_PERCENTILE_C/S 0.093/0.97→0.083/1.11, HILL_ROOKIE 0.128/0.865→0.153/0.885.

reproduction.command: cd /home/user/riskittogetthebrisket && .venv/bin/python -c "import sys,json;sys.path.insert(0,'.');from src.model_registry.versioning import ModelRegistry;from src.model_registry.hill_masters import VALIDATED_PARAMS,CONSTANT_NAMES;r=ModelRegistry.load('hill_scope_masters');v=r.champion;print('shipped:',len(CONSTANT_NAMES),'scored:',v.holdout['params'],'validated:',VALIDATED_PARAMS,'qualified:',v.qualified,'confidence:',v.confidence)"
reproduction.expected: the scored parameter set equals the shipped parameter set
reproduction.actual: shipped: 8 · scored: {'c': 0.11, 's': 1.11} · validated: ('HILL_PERCENTILE_C','HILL_PERCENTILE_S') · qualified: True · confidence: measured

userImpact: Every IDP value on /rankings and in every trade engine moved by up to −34.6% (−23.9% at rank 200, −15.0% at rank 100) in a change whose only evidence was an offense-board RMSE. An IDP-heavy roster was repriced against no measurement, and the payload labels the champion `confidence: measured`.

priorFinding.note: Confirmed and quantified: the prior finding states the 6-of-8 ratio; this adds the per-rank curve deltas that make the size of the unscored change concrete.

whatWorks: hill_masters.VALIDATED_PARAMS is an explicit, correct in-code admission of exactly this gap.
rootCause: evaluate_offense_master is the only scorer that was ever written; the version/promotion machinery was built to carry a whole parameter set and no one narrowed the verdict to what it covers.
requiredRepair: Either build GLOBAL/IDP scorers over their own held-out boards, or split the registry so a promotion moves only HILL_PERCENTILE_C/S and the other six require a separate explicit human decision. At minimum, ModelVersion.qualified/confidence must be per-parameter, not per-version.
